name: experimental-design
tagline_zh: 数据还没到手，先别急着跑实验。帮你选设计、随机化、分组、排布处理组合，让结果一出来就能看懂，不白忙活。
tagline_en: Before you collect data, let this skill pick the design, randomize, block, and lay out treatments—so results make.
desc_en: Design experiments and studies BEFORE data is collected — choosing a design, randomizing, blocking, and laying out treatment combinations so results are interpretable. Use whenever someone is planning a study, asks how to assign subjects/samples to groups, mentions randomization, blocking, stratification, controls, factorial or fractional-factorial designs, design of experiments (DOE), screening m
why_zh: 它把随机化、区组、因子设计这些统计细节直接变成可执行步骤，比你自己翻教科书快得多。
why_en: Turns randomization, blocking, and factorial design into actionable steps—faster than flipping through a stats textbook.
